summary: Iteration 34 - Backend Testing of Phase 1-3 Features. All 23 tests passed (100%). Fixed 2 bugs: Report model import missing, visits.py using undefined get_limits function.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Phase 1-3 features tested and working. Comment permission system enforces everyone/friends/nobody correctly. Community photos N+1 fix verified with batch upvote counts. Report system validates type/reason. Friend limit removed (max_friends=999999). Diary hybrid model configured (3/month free, unlimited pro). View all visits returns paginated list with has_diary and visibility. Profile returns comment_permission and has_diary on recent_visits. Landmarks return is_visited field.

bugs_fixed.fix: Added Report to imports from models.all
Changed to get_user_limits() which is properly imported from utils.auth

POST /api/activities/{id}/comment.notes: Respects comment_permission - nobody blocks all, friends blocks non-friends

GET /api/users/{user_id}/visits.notes: Returns paginated visits with has_diary, visibility fields, supports skip/limit

GET /api/users/{user_id}/profile.notes: Returns comment_permission and has_diary on recent_visits

POST /api/reports.notes: Validates report_type and reason, prevents self-reporting

GET /api/landmarks/{id}/community-photos.notes: Returns photos with batch upvote counts (N+1 fix verified)

GET /api/countries/{id}/community-photos.notes: Returns photos with batch upvote counts

GET /api/friends.notes: No friend limit error means unlimited friends working
